info.title: Beans News API & MCP
info.description: Read-only publisher-content API for Articles, Sources, Stories, related reading, and external mentions. Collections return `{data, pagination, meta}` with `pagination.limit`, `pagination.num_results` (this page only), `pagination.next_cursor`, and `meta.as_of`. Empty collections return HTTP 200 with `data: []`. Missing detail resources return HTTP 404. Errors return `{ "error": { "code", "message" } }`. Unknown or route-inapplicable query parameters return HTTP 400. `content_type=post` is not a valid request filter and returns HTTP 400; `post` may still appear on Article responses. REST and MCP operations require `Authorization: Bearer <api-key>` except `/beans/health`.

q.name: q
q.description: Optional relevance query. When supplied, score_threshold may be omitted. score_threshold without q returns HTTP 400. On Sources and label routes, a case-insensitive prefix query.

score_threshold.name: score_threshold
score_threshold.description: Optional relevance threshold used only with q. Rejected when q is absent.

content_type.name: content_type
content_type.description: Filterable Article type. `post` is response-only: `content_type=post` returns HTTP 400. The other 14 stored types remain filterable. Omit to include every stored type.

authors.name: authors
authors.description: Author text filters. Every supplied value must match (CSV).

tags.name: tags
tags.description: Normalized tag terms. Every supplied term must match (CSV).

from.name: from
from.description: UTC lower timestamp bound. YYYY-MM-DD means 00:00:00Z.

to.name: to
to.description: UTC upper timestamp bound. YYYY-MM-DD means 00:00:00Z.

full_content.name: full_content
full_content.description: Request body content when available. This does not guarantee a full publisher copy for every Article. Handle a missing content value and use the canonical url for attribution.

cursor.name: cursor
cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from pagination.next_cursor. Send it unchanged as the next request cursor. Never construct or decode cursor tokens.

min_article_count.name: min_article_count
min_article_count.description: Minimum number of Articles in a Story.

limit.description: Requested page size for this response.

num_results.description: Number of records in this page, not a total-match count.

next_cursor.description: Opaque next-page token, or null when there is no next page.

as_of.description: UTC time this collection snapshot was produced.

content_type.description: Stored Article type. `post` may appear here but is not a valid request filter.

content.description: Present only when full_content=true and Beans has body content available. Not a universal full-text guarantee.

story_id.description: Stable Story UUID. Present when the Article belongs to a Story.

articles.description: Service-relative member-Article path. For the public gateway, request /beans plus this path.

BearerAuth.description: API key in the Authorization header as `Bearer <api-key>`.
